COIN.narrative: The engine calls this a watch, and the outside picture says the same thing in different words. S/R Breakout wants a long at 148.45 with a 143.4912 stop into 172.1914 (4.79 R:R; T1 155.23, T2 172.84), but conviction is only 62, size_factor 0.43, htf_lean is bearish, and confirmation is still 'forming' at 15 - price is sitting at support 147.94 without the reclaim of 155.23, without a rejection/reclaim candle, and without the >=1.2x volume bar. Almost everything the AI layer adds is headwind. COIN fell 3.54% into the Friday close as the crypto tape rolled over (BTC ~$62.7-62.9K with every trend horizon turned negative on 8/13, $131M of BTC-ETF outflows, and the SEC canceling a tokenization-related meeting on 8/14), and the 8/7 Michigan ruling took a leg out of the prediction-markets growth story. After the 7/30 Q2 miss - the third straight - the Street compressed targets on 7/31 (Benchmark 270->230, Needham 220->177, Mizuho 200->155, Baird to 130, Barclays 99->95) while mostly holding ratings: estimates down, conviction not yet capitulated. This is a continuation-class long fighting its own tape, which by the engine's own logic means premature rather than contrarian. Two things cut the other way, and both are weaker than they first look - ARK's ~$8M buy was around 8/3, right after the miss, so it is not someone buying this week's selloff; and the name is now a crowded short, which is fuel if a turn starts but is not evidence that one has. The practical read: wait for the three confirmations the engine already named, size no larger than the 0.43 factor if they arrive, and know that the 2026-09-15 CLARITY Act cloture vote and the 2026-09-16 FOMC both sit inside the 30-day window that T2 depends on.
COIN.reconciliation: Alignment is 'agree': the engine's watch/needs-confirmation verdict, 62 conviction and 0.43 size_factor already encode caution, and the qualitative read points the same way rather than against it. The AI layer sharpens rather than contradicts - it names why the setup is unconfirmed (crypto tape deteriorating, adverse policy flow, post-miss estimate cuts) and where the engine is blind (sector=null means its 'risk-on, favor breakouts' market posture is an equity read that never prices the crypto complex driving this name). Stance is cautionary rather than supportive because klass is continuation fighting a bearish htf_lean, which per the conflict rule is discounted hard, and because two in-window binaries (CLARITY Act 09-15, FOMC 09-16) sit inside the trade window. size_hint 'trim' is a nudge only; the engine's 0.43 size_factor remains authoritative.
